events.verdict: Adams (OKC) firms up in a legal screening position in Smart's (BOS) path and does not deliver any contact.
Tatum (BOS) makes marginal contact with Westbrook's (OKC) body that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Adams (OKC) makes marginal contact with Horford (BOS) that does not affect his ability to grab the rebound.
Abrines (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position during the drive by Irving (BOS).
George (OKC) jumps vertically contesting the driving shot attempt by Tatum (BOS) and absorbs the contact to the body. He cleanly dislodges the ball from Tatum.
Grant (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position on the drive by Tatum (BOS).
LLB shows Westbrook (OKC) has his arm extended outward, but he does not extend it through Smart's (BOS) space and dislodge him from his position.
Irving (BOS) makes contact with Adams' (OKC) arm that affects his ability to control the pass.
George (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position on Tatum's (BOS) jump shot.
Abrines (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position during the drive by Irving (BOS) and the contact to the body is incidental.
Abrines (OKC) legally contests Irving's (BOS) layup.
Grant (OKC) firms up in a screening position in Tatum's (BOS) path and absorbs the contact.
Adams (OKC) does not deliver any contact to Smart (BOS) on the screen.
Grant (OKC) makes marginal body contact with Tatum (BOS) that does not affect his ability to secure the rebound.
Schroder (OKC) maintains legal guarding position during the drive by Smart (BOS).
Adams (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position on Morris' (BOS) jump shot.
Adams (OKC) briefly engages with Smart (BOS) when he moves toward the basket but he does not use his arms to deliver any contact.
Smart (BOS) maintains a legal guarding position on Westbrook's (OKC) jump shot.
Adams (OKC) places his hands on Morris' (BOS) back during the rebound, but he does not extend them or dislodge Morris from his position.
George (OKC) makes contact with the arm and body of Morris (BOS) that affects his SQBR.
Rozier (BOS) maintains a legal guarding position on George's (OKC) jump shot.

events.verdict: After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of Thunder possession is overturned to Celtics possession.
Schroder (OKC) and Horford (BOS) briefly engage and disengage during the inbound.
Adams (OKC) commits a take foul on Horford (BOS).
Irving (BOS) makes clean contact with the ball on the pass to Abrines (OKC).

Adams (OKC) briefly grabs Morris' (BOS) arm during the rebound, but releases and does not affect his ability to go for the rebound.
